name: adcopilot-linkedin-ads
description: LinkedIn Ads help in your AI client, through AdCopilot. It reads the LinkedIn ad accounts you connect (campaign groups, campaigns, ads' names, status and review, conversion rules, the Insight Tag and results), audits them and analyses their results, and changes nothing in them. It also checks your LinkedIn Insight Tag in Google Tag Manager, reports LinkedIn traffic in Google Analytics (GA4), plans B2B campaigns, drafts Sponsored Content copy and does the budget math. Every Tag Manager change is staged only on your yes and never published for you. Made by Atromx Intelligence, not by LinkedIn.
